spans.s:
cl. 1. Ā. (Dhātup. xxii, 61) प्रवते (pf. पुप्रुवे, ŚBr.; aor. प्रोष्ठाः, ĀśvŚr.),
to spring up, Bhaṭṭ. :
Caus. प्रावयति (aor. अपुप्रवत्, or अपिप्रवत्), to reach to (acc.), ib. (cf. Pāṇ. i, 3, 86) :
Desid. of Caus. पुप्रावयिषति or पिप्रावयिषति, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 81, Sch. (cf. अति-√ प्रु, अप-√ प्रु &c.; and √ प्लु).
(ifc.) See अन्तरिक्ष-, उद-, उपरि- and कृष्ण-प्रु॑त्.

cl. 1. P. Ā. प्रो॑थति, ˚ते, to pant, neigh, snort (as a horse), RV.; ĀśvŚr. :
Caus. प्रोथयति, to employ force, Āpast. :
Intens. (only p. पो॑प्रुथत्) to snort aloud, RV. i, 30, 16 (cf. √ प्रोथ्).

etym.s: [cf. Lat. pruīna for prusvīna; Goth. frius; Germ. friosan, frieren; Eng. freeze.]

spans.s: 3. प्रुष् cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. xvii, 53) to burn.
प्रुषित॑—प्सु (˚त॑-), mfn. dappled, piebald (as horses), ib.
the rainy season, Uṇ. i, 151, Sch.
(or प्रु॑ष्वा) f. a drop of water, hoar-frost, ice, AV.; VS.; ŚBr.
Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to fall in drops, trickle, Uṇ. i, 151.
